page.overview:
Who is Bowspritz?

Bowspritz was a Tynnan Jedi Master, a noted biologist, and the beastmaster at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the years preceding the Ruusan Reformation. Contributing research to the Jedi Order during his service, Bowspritz was immortalized in the Order after authoring several chapters of the Temple guidebook titled The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force. In those chapters, he passed down information on the species of the galaxy.

A male Tynnan, Bowspritz joined the Jedi Order at a young age, and was accepted as a Padawan some time before the outbreak of the New Sith Wars. While apprenticed to a Jedi Master, the young Jedi spent a month studying the needler crabs of Jodaka and updating the outdated material found in the Jedi Archives with the data gathered there. Bowspritz discovered and named the furred o'cerrys of the Expansion Region moon Alchenaut, and encountered both a slumbering exogorth and a neebray manta in the depths of space. Furthermore, the Tynnan's research also extended to the Troiken indictidile and the Mygeetan whiteworm. Like most Jedi of the era, Master Bowspritz served the Order as a member of the Army of Light, regardless of a past in studying the ways of the Jedi Consular, in the crusades against the Brotherhood of Darkness. Once the Ruusan Reformations took effect, Master Bowspritz returned to the Temple to continue studies on biology and galactic cultures.

At some point in Bowspritz's career, a number of run-ins with various Squibs helped him out of several hazardous situations; however, Bowspritz would later recollect that those dealings exerted some strain on the credit-line he received from the Temple. He also compiled societal and cultural information on other species including Bith, Bothans, Duros, Herglics, Humans, Hutts, and Sullustans. Bowspritz earned the title of beastmaster after extensive research into the manifestations of the Force in galactic fauna. During a mission to the Exploration Corps outpost on the Outer Rim Territories world Ord Canfre, Master Bowspritz encountered an akk dog and in so doing discovered how the Force played a part in the bonds that the akks formed with their trainers.

When Bowspritz's contemporary Masters proposed that a guidebook to the life of the Jedi be written, the biologist agreed to work on the project, contributing three chapters. Describing in turn a galactic bestiary, advanced culture, and politics, Master Bowspritz's insights as a biologist and a Consular were meant to serve as the starting point for research into relations with different species both sentient and non-sentient. the Tynnan's writings were later annotated and critiqued by Thame Cerulian, Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano, and Luke Skywalker in a copy of the guidebook that ended up in each Jedi's subsequent possession.
